itt_pdf.stage: Conditions of Participation - Legal Eligibility and Authorization
itt_pdf.title: Conditions of Participation - Legal Eligibility and Authorization
itt_pdf.notes: PSQ Question 1: Participant must confirm legal eligibility and authorization for each city (Peshawar, Haripur, D.I Khan, Gilgit, Skardu, Quetta). Scoring: Yes = 1, No = 0. Minimum pass score = Yes for all cities.

source_refs.excerpt: Please confirm whether you are legally eligible and authorized to perform services in each of the cities specified below, including compliance with all applicable tax registration and regulatory requirements.

itt_pdf.stage: Conditions of Participation - Capability to Supply, Install, and Support
itt_pdf.title: Conditions of Participation - Capability to Supply, Install, and Support
itt_pdf.notes: PSQ Question 1 (continued): Participant must confirm capability to supply, install, and provide after-sales support in all listed cities. Scoring: Yes = 1, No = 0. Minimum pass score = Yes for all cities.

source_refs.excerpt: Please confirm that your organization is capable of supplying, installing, and providing after-sales support in all the listed cities.

itt_pdf.title: Conditions of Participation - OEM Authorization
itt_pdf.notes: PSQ Question 2: Participant must provide valid OEM Authorization Letters or equivalent documentary evidence. Scoring: Yes = 1, No = 0. Minimum pass score = Yes.

source_refs.excerpt: OEM Authorization - Please provide valid Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Authorization Letters or equivalent documentary evidence confirming that you are authorized to supply, install, support, and provide warranty services for all proposed solution components.

itt_pdf.stage: Conditions of Participation - Economic and Financial Standing
itt_pdf.title: Conditions of Participation - Economic and Financial Standing
itt_pdf.threshold: Acceptable level of financial risk (assessed via turnover, solvency ratios, profitability ratios)
itt_pdf.notes: British Council assesses turnover relative to contract value, solvency ratios, and profitability ratios based on two most recent accounts or audited financial statements. Minimum criteria apply; British Council may require further information.

source_refs.excerpt: In order to facilitate British Council's assessment of a Participant's economic and financial standing, British Council will assess turnover relative to the Contract Value, solvency ratios and profitability ratios.

itt_pdf.stage: Stage 1: Tender Completion and Mandatory Requirements Check
itt_pdf.title: Stage 1: Tender Completion and Mandatory Requirements Check
itt_pdf.threshold: All mandatory requirements must be met; tender must be correctly completed with all necessary information provided
itt_pdf.notes: Tender responses will be checked to ensure they have been completed correctly and all necessary information has been provided. Tenderers with correctly completed responses and all relevant information provided and all mandatory requirements as set out in the specification met will proceed to Stage 2. Any tender responses not correctly completed in accordance with the requirements of this ITT and/or containing omissions may be rejected at this point. Where a tender response is rejected at this point it will automatically be disqualified and will not be further evaluated.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 1: Tender responses will be checked to ensure that they have been completed correctly and all necessary information has been provided. Tenderers responses correctly completed with all relevant information being provided and all mandatory requirements as set out in the specification met will proceed to Stage 2. Any tender responses not correctly completed in accordance with the requirements of this ITT and/or containing omissions may be rejected at this point.

itt_pdf.stage: Stage 2: Selection Questionnaire and Supplier Qualification Review
itt_pdf.title: Stage 2: Selection Questionnaire and Supplier Qualification Review
itt_pdf.threshold: Potential supplier must meet all qualification criteria set out in the Selection Questionnaire
itt_pdf.notes: The completed Selection Questionnaire will then be reviewed to confirm that the potential supplier meets all of the qualification criteria set out in the questionnaire. Potential suppliers that meet the qualification criteria will proceed to Stage 3. Potential suppliers that do not meet the qualification criteria set out in the Selection Questionnaire may be excluded from the Procurement Process at this point. Where a potential supplier is excluded at this point, its tender response will be rejected in full and not evaluated further and the supplier will automatically be disqualified from this Procurement Process.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 2: The completed Selection Questionnaire will then be reviewed to confirm that the potential supplier meets all of the qualification criteria set out in the questionnaire. Potential suppliers that meet the qualification criteria will proceed to Stage 3. Potential suppliers that do not meet the qualification criteria set out in the Selection Questionnaire may be excluded from the Procurement Process at this point.

itt_pdf.title: Stage 3 – Detailed Tender Response Evaluation
itt_pdf.notes: If a bidder succeeds in passing Stages 1 and 2, its detailed tender response to British Council requirements is evaluated using award criteria and weightings. Information from Selection Questionnaire responses may also be verified.

source_refs.excerpt: If a bidder succeeds in passing Stages 1 and 2 of the evaluation, then it will have its detailed tender response to the British Council's requirements evaluated in accordance with the evaluation methodology set out below.

itt_pdf.title: Social Value
itt_pdf.notes: Scored using 0-10 point scale by evaluation panel

source_refs.excerpt: Criteria: Social Value, Weighting: 10%

itt_pdf.title: Relevant Experience and Clientele
itt_pdf.notes: Scored using 0-10 point scale by evaluation panel

source_refs.excerpt: Criteria: Relevant Experience and Clientele, Weighting: 15%

itt_pdf.stage: Scope of Work and Delivery Timelines
itt_pdf.title: Scope of Work and Delivery Timelines
itt_pdf.notes: Scored using 0-10 point scale by evaluation panel

source_refs.excerpt: Criteria: Scope of Work and Delivery Timelines, Weighting: 35%

itt_pdf.title: Commercial
itt_pdf.notes: Evaluated based on Overall Price. Maximum score of 10 awarded to lowest price. Other responses scored using formula: (Lowest Overall Price / Overall Price being evaluated) × 10, rounded to two decimal places.

source_refs.excerpt: Criteria: Commercial, Weighting: 40%

A maximum offer score of 10 will be awarded to the tender response offering the lowest 'Overall Price'. Other tender responses will be awarded a mark by application of the following formula: (Lowest Overall Price/Overall Price being evaluated) x 10 (rounded to two decimal places) = commercial score.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale – Excellent
itt_pdf.notes: Excellent – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas evidence requested in the level of detail requested. This is a detailed excellent response that meets all aspects of the requirement leaving no ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement.

source_refs.excerpt: 10 – Excellent – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas evidence requested in the level of detail requested.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale – Good
itt_pdf.notes: Good – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas of evidence requested, but contains some trivial omissions in relation to the level of detail requested. This is a good response that meets all aspects of the requirement with only a trivial level ambiguity.

source_refs.excerpt: 7 – Good – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas of evidence requested, but contains some trivial omissions in relation to the level of detail requested in terms of either the response or the evidence.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale – Adequate
itt_pdf.notes: Adequate – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement, but not all of the areas of evidence requested have been provided. This is an adequate response, but with some limited ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement.

source_refs.excerpt: 5 – Adequate – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement, but not all of the areas of evidence requested have been provided.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale – Poor
itt_pdf.notes: Poor – The response does not demonstrate that the bidder meets the requirement in one or more areas. This is a poor response with significant ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement.

source_refs.excerpt: 3 – Poor – The response does not demonstrate that the bidder meets the requirement in one or more areas. This, therefore, is a poor response with significant ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement due to the failure by the bidder to show that it meets one or more areas of the requirement.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale – Unacceptable
itt_pdf.notes: Unacceptable – The response is non-compliant with the requirements of the ITT and/or no response has been provided.

source_refs.excerpt: 0 – Unacceptable – The response is non-compliant with the requirements of the ITT and/or no response has been provided.

itt_pdf.title: Moderation and Application of Weightings
itt_pdf.notes: The evaluation panel will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores as a percentage of overall tender score are obtained by applying relevant weighting factors. Percentage scores for each award criteria are amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

source_refs.excerpt: The evaluation panel appointed for this procurement will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores in terms of a percentage of the overall tender score will be obtained by applying the relevant weighting factors set out as part of the award criteria table above. The percentage scores for each award criteria will be amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

itt_pdf.title: Winning Tender Selection
itt_pdf.notes: The winning tender response shall be the tender response scoring the highest percentage score out of 100 when applying the evaluation methodology, which is also supported by any required verification evidence relating to Exclusion Grounds or Conditions of Participation responses.

source_refs.excerpt: The winning tender response shall be the tender response scoring the highest percentage score out of 100 when applying the above evaluation methodology, which is also supported by any required verification evidence (to include, without limitation, any updated information or references relating to any Exclusion Grounds or Conditions of Participation responses) obtained by the Authority relating to any self-certification or other requirements referred to in the Procurement Specific Questionnaire.

Potential suppliers that do not meet the qualification criteria set out in the Selection Questionnaire may be excluded from the Procurement Process at this point.

roots.title: Stage 3 – Detailed Tender Response Evaluation
roots.notes: If a bidder succeeds in passing Stages 1 and 2, its detailed tender response to British Council requirements is evaluated using award criteria and weightings. Information from Selection Questionnaire responses may also be verified.

roots.title: Moderation and Application of Weightings
roots.notes: The evaluation panel will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores as a percentage of overall tender score are obtained by applying relevant weighting factors. Percentage scores for each award criteria are amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

source_refs.excerpt: The evaluation panel appointed for this procurement will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores in terms of a percentage of the overall tender score will be obtained by applying the relevant weighting factors set out as part of the award criteria table above. The percentage scores for each award criteria will be amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

roots.title: Winning Tender Selection
roots.notes: The winning tender response shall be the tender response scoring the highest percentage score out of 100 when applying the evaluation methodology, which is also supported by any required verification evidence relating to Exclusion Grounds or Conditions of Participation responses.
